title: A closed constructible image of a quasi-compact space is closed
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the image of a quasi-compact space under a map whose image is constructible and whose fibres are closed is closed (author lemma at source lines 2915-2920, label lemma-closed-constructible-image). The proof (source lines 2922-2941) tests the closedness characterization of a constructible subset on a finite cover of the target and uses quasi-compactness of the fibres on each piece (proof lines 2922-2940). The test on the pieces of the cover is the content. H3.
